svg.title: When the end-to-end tests run
svg.desc: A pull request runs the end-to-end tests only when it changes the app, its tests or their workflow; otherwise both required checks pass at once. The check nextcloud then runs every supported version, and the check nextcloud on PostgreSQL, MariaDB and S3 runs the newest version there when the change can behave differently on another database or storage, and passes at once otherwise. Every push to main and every night run both, and every Monday the canary runs the tests against the coming Nextcloud.
